recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，深藍色的小淋巴細胞浸潤緊貼著骨小樑表面分布，沿骨小樑形成帶狀或新月形聚集（paratrabecular aggregates），這種貼骨小樑的淋巴聚集是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的典型型態。
features: Dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrates hugging and wrapping bony trabeculae (paratrabecular pattern)
Aggregates follow the contour of the trabeculae, forming band-like and crescentic collars
Intervening marrow shows residual trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered fat spaces
Overall marrow cellularity is increased for most ages
Cytologic detail of the lymphoid cells is not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows dense lymphoid aggregates closely applied to and spreading along the surfaces of bony trabeculae. The intertrabecular spaces contain residual trilineage hematopoiesis and fat. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The paratrabecular distribution is characteristic of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, which should be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL2).

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and interstitial, containing mixed T and B cells.
MCL can be paratrabecular but more often interstitial or nodular, and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.
CLL/SLL typically shows non-paratrabecular nodular, interstitial or diffuse infiltrates of CD5+ CD23+ small round cells.
SMZL characteristically shows intrasinusoidal infiltration and nodular aggregates, and is CD10 negative.
